name: KiCad Track Gloss
description: Shorten or simplify explicitly selected PCB track chains.
description_full: KiCad Track Gloss replaces safe selected-track staircases with shorter or simpler 0/45/90-degree chains. It reads KiCad board constraints and effective netclasses, generates deterministic global and fallback batch candidates, and asks the official KiCad DRC engine to select the highest-saving valid candidate on temporary board copies. Unselected copper remains immutable.
